verdict.rationale: Docs mention AI-powered categorization/compliance ('every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant') and an 'Invoice Coding Agent' for automatic multi-line bill coding, suggesting some AI-driven categorization exists, but this targets AP invoice coding rather than expense receipts specifically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI reading/OCR-ing receipts, AI-suggested memos, and AI-based duplicate or fraud detection for expenses.
